summary: Aitkin County, MN steel tower in Savanna State Forest, listed standing at 100 ft; sources disagree on whether a CCC or a state tower came first in 1934. No access or staffing found.

facts.design: four-legged steel tower, 100 ft, with metal observation room on top (1980 survey description)
facts.agency: Disputed: Civilian Conservation Corps per Forest Lookouts; the state per the local Aitkin County history

events.note: Forest Lookouts: the Civilian Conservation Corps erected a 100-foot International Derrick tower with an inside ladder
Local history: the state built a fire tower on Ball Bluff hill, 60 feet tall; conflicts with the 100-foot account
Local history: a new tower was built and the old one taken down
Minnesota Department of Transportation survey description of the tower: four-legged steel, 100 ft, metal observation room on top

evidence.supports: CCC built 100-foot International Derrick tower in 1934 (Forest Lookouts account)
evidence.quote: 1934: The Civilian Conservation Corps erected a 100-foot International Derrick tower with an inside ladder.

evidence.supports: state built 60-foot tower on Ball Bluff hill in 1934 (local history account)
evidence.quote: In 1934, the state built a fire tower on Ball Bluff hill. It was 60 feet tall.

evidence.supports: new tower in 1936, old one taken down
evidence.quote: In 1936, a new tower was built, and the old tower was taken down.
THE LOOKOUT TOWER IS A FOUR LEGGED, 100 FEET HIGH, STEEL STRUCTURE
WITH A METAL OBSERVATION ROOM ON THE TOP
DESCRIBED BY MN DEPT OF TRANSP 1980

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Used 100 ft (30.5 m) for the standing tower because the 1980 survey description and Wikidata both give 100 ft. The 60-ft figure belongs to the 1934 tower in the local history.

notes_for_editor: The two accounts of the first tower conflict on builder (CCC vs state), height (100 ft vs 60 ft), and the 1936 replacement, which appears only in the local history. Both are reported; the sources do not say which tower stands today, so the built events are not merged. The 1980 survey describes the tower the record calls standing. The NGS PID RN1233 appears on the Forest Lookouts page and is not in the record; consider adding it to registers. A Wikimedia Commons photo (Ball Bluff Lookout Tower.jpg) is linked from Wikidata, but its license was not checked, so no photo is added. No access, staffing, or current-condition sources were found.
